<p>Dear QGIS Community</p>
<p>Last year we held our first ever call for Grant Proposals and it was a great success. If you are an early adopter using QGIS 3.0 preview builds, you can already try out some of the new capabilities that have arrived in QGIS thanks to these grants.</p>
<p>We are very pleased to announce the second round of Grants is now available to QGIS Contributors. The deadline for this round is <strong>Sunday, 19 March 2017</strong>. All the details for the Grant are described in the <span style="color:#339966;"><strong><a style="color:#339966;" href="https://goo.gl/forms/Qj1jiC5RdUQez2CO2" target="_blank">application form</a></strong></span>, and for more context we encourage you to also read these articles:</p>
